summary: Official Tanzania e-Ardhi GeoServer discovery found public parcel-like spatial-unit layers and a bounded Moshi-area response. Three full multipolygons were retained with UUID-only canonical identities. This is research evidence, not runtime admission.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Swahili discovery queries, results, and actual URLs are recorded in city-3247-moshi.json under freshResearch.queries.
requestOutcomes: All executed first-party GET/POST requests, statuses, schema inspection, WFS capabilities, bounded zero-hit and positive-hit responses, and the GraphQL error are recorded in city-3247-moshi.json under requests.

requestCoordinates.coordinateOrderNote: Exact WUP latitude/longitude preserved; no coordinate shift applied.

geometryQuality: Three complete WFS GeoJSON multipolygons retained; no raw source attributes retained; no topology qualification performed.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not completed as a parcel-containing test: the narrower spatial_units query returned zero, and no point hit is required to retain bounded nearby geometry.
